scope: Single-entry quality review of Merlin. The existing browser assistant was verified as an active, distinct product; no catalog expansion or lifecycle change.

accepted.name: Merlin
accepted.description: AI-powered browser extension and web assistant that brings multi-model chat into webpages and search, with page-aware Q&A, web research, summaries of websites, YouTube videos and documents, rewriting, translation, custom knowledge Projects and prompt-driven diagrams or code snippets.
accepted.userValue: For students, researchers, creators and professionals who want to research, understand and transform web content without repeatedly switching between browser tabs and separate AI apps.

notes: Disambiguation: this catalog entry is the Merlin browser assistant at getmerlin.in. Other products using the Merlin name and different official domains were not treated as the same product.
